🎙
Statement
by Ambassador-at-Large of the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs
Rodion Miroshnik
at
the 63rd Session of the UN Human Rights Council
(Geneva, September 30, 2026)
💬
Building on the right of peoples to self-determination enshrined in
the UN Charter
,
the Vienna Declaration and Programme of Action
contains
a provision recognising the right of peoples to take any legitimate action to exercise this inalienable right.
Exactly four years ago, the residents of the DPR, LPR, Zaporozhye and Kherson regions
exercised their legitimate right to self-determination
and
voted in referendums
to join the Russian Federation
.
For this honest, open and democratic choice,
the Kiev authorities are
taking revenge
on the people of Donbass and Novorossiya
. They are taking revenge through
terrorist attacks and war crimes
against children, women and the elderly.
Over the past four years, criminal acts by Ukrainian militants have killed
more than 9,000 civilians
and injured
over 25,500
.
More than 300 children have been killed, and over 1,500 wounded or maimed
.
☝️
Their blood is on the hands of Zelensky and his entourage – but not theirs alone.
It is also on the hands of
those who allocated €90 billion this year
to prolong the bloodshed, those who keep supplying terrorists with more weapons, and those who pay them to kill.
❗️
I call on Ukraine and its Western sponsors to recall
the letter and spirit of the Vienna Declaration and Programme of Action
, recognise and accept the choice made by the people of Crimea, Donbass and Novorossiya, and
put an end to this criminal bloodshed
.
#KievRegimeCrimes

item.title: ✉️ On September 30, Vladimir Putin sent greetings to President of the Republic of Abkhazia Badra Gunba on the occasion of Victory and Independence Day.
item.description: ✉️ On September 30, Vladimir Putin sent greetings to President of the Republic of Abkhazia Badra Gunba on the occasion of Victory and Independence Day. ✍️ The message reads, in part: “Please accept my heartfelt congratulations on Victory and Independence Day. This glorious holiday symbolises the resilience, courage, and unity of the people of Abkhazia, who upheld their legitimate right to a free and peaceful life. Relations between Russia and Abkhazia are marked by friendship and alliance . I am confident that they will continue to strengthen, for the benefit of our peoples and in the interests of ensuring regional stability and security. Russia will continue to assist its Abkhaz partners in every way in addressing key tasks relating to state-building and socioeconomic development”. Russia's President wished the Leader of Abkhazia sound health and every success, and to all citizens of the Republic, happiness and well-being. #RussiaAbkhazia

🎙
Vladimir Putin
held a meeting
with President of the Alliance of Independent Social Democrats Milorad Dodik and Prime Minister of Republika Srpska Savo Minic
(Moscow, September 29, 2026)
💬
Vladimir Putin:
In 2026,
a high-level delegation from Republika Srpska
took part in
the celebrations held in Moscow to mark the 81st anniversary of Victory in the Great Patriotic War
. We are
very grateful
to you for your participation.
The partnership between Russia and Republika Srpska is based on
a time-tested friendship
. For many years throughout our history, Russia, the Russian people, and the Serbian people have maintained
special ties
.
We will, of course, continue our efforts to further develop our relations
. This includes political dialogue, cooperation within the UN framework, implementation of joint economic projects, and, naturally, our traditionally strong contacts in the cultural and humanitarian spheres.
Together, we strive to establish a more just world order
. As I have already mentioned, we consistently support Republika Srpska at multilateral platforms, including the UN Security Council.
🗳
The date of the general elections in Bosnia and Herzegovina is approaching
: they are to be held very soon, on October 4. Russian representatives will participate as
observers
of the voting process. We wish success to the ruling coalition you represent.
We trust that no external influence will alter the views of the majority of the population or prevent patriotic forces from securing a mandate
to continue pursuing a course that safeguards the inalienable rights and interests of Republika Srpska within Bosnia and Herzegovina and fosters constructive cooperation with Russia.
We realise the complexity of the situation.
You are aware of our position on the post-Yugoslavia settlement: since the collapse of Yugoslavia, a fairer attitude towards the Serbs – the Serbian people – has been both necessary and essential for ensuring stability. After all, discrediting even a single participant in this settlement process cannot lead to stability and peace in this challenging region.
🤝
I would like to reiterate that
we sincerely wish you success
.
***
We are well aware that the Serbs are not seeking any special status or exceptions to the rules for themselves
. On the contrary, you are committed to fulfilling all arrangements and previously concluded agreements.
You have mentioned
Dayton
. I repeat:
you are not asking for anything special for yourselves
, only that the decisions adopted at the international level are implemented.
❗️
We consider it unacceptable to impose an external will on the Serbs
, especially in violation of previously adopted international agreements.

item.title: ⚡️ #KievRegimeCrimes Ambassador-at-Large of the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs
item.description: #KievRegimeCrimes ⚡️ Ambassador-at-Large of the Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs Rodion Miroshnik : 💬 Over the past week , Kiev regime militants focused their attacks on medical personnel, emergency workers and volunteers. They repeatedly targeted medical teams in the Belgorod and Zaporozhye regions. These crimes resulted in the death of one medical worker and injuries to seven others. In the Zaporozhye Region, a terrorist attack on a civilian vehicle delivering humanitarian aid killed three volunteers from the Omsk Region and injured another. The highest numbers of civilian casualties over the past week were recorded in the Belgorod, Zaporozhye, Kursk and Kherson regions and the LPR . Kiev’s armed groups continued their criminal strategy of “energy terror” in the Belgorod, Zaporozhye, Kursk and Kherson regions, the LPR and DPR, and the Krasnodar Territory. Ukrainian strikes on electrical substations left communities in the Krasnoyaruzhsky and Grayvoronsky districts of the Belgorod Region without electricity. A drone strike also damaged a radiation monitoring station at the Zaporozhskaya Nuclear Power Plant . On September 21-27 , shelling by Ukrainian neo-Nazis resulted in 315 civilian casualties: 274 civilians were injured, including nine children, and 41 people were killed. Over the seven days , Ukrainian militants fired at least 8,033 munitions at civilian facilities on Russian territory.

Even before Ukraine gained statehood in 1991,
its 1990 Declaration of State Sovereignty
stipulated that
“The people of Ukraine shall be the single source of the state authority in the Republic”
.
The same document
stated that
“the Ukrainian nation has exercised its inalienable right to self-determination”
to leave the USSR. Thirty-five years ago,
the Western world applauded this move
and swiftly and widely recognised the new state that had appeared on the map.
12 years ago, in response to
the illegal coup in Kiev
and the unconstitutional so-called
“anti-terrorist operation”
launched against them,
the residents of Ukraine’s Lugansk and Donetsk regions likewise exercised their “inalienable right to self-determination”
and voted in referendums to leave Ukraine. Yet this expression of the will of more than four million people in Donbass
received no such approval in the West
.
👉
This exercise of direct democracy by a population outraged by
the coup
was branded
“separatism”
,
“occupation”
and
an attack on
“Ukraine’s territorial integrity”
.
Exactly four years ago, the residents of the Lugansk and Donetsk People’s Republics and the Zaporozhye and Kherson regions
also exercised their “inalienable right to self-determination”
and
voted in referendums to join the Russian Federation
. Since then, these regions have been
new constituent entities of Russia
and part of its territory under
the Constitution
.
👉
Yet both Kiev and the West chose to describe this exercise of direct democracy as
“Russian occupation”
as well.
A few days ago, UN Secretary-General
Antonio Guterres
displayed
similar double standards
.
In his view, the question of self-determination for Crimea, Donbass and Novorossiya must be approached
exclusively through Ukraine’s “territorial integrity”
, whereas
the issue of Greenland
must be resolved on the basis of both Denmark’s territorial integrity and the right of Greenland’s population to self-determination.
In other words, the rights of the people of Greenland are one thing, while those of the people of Crimea and Donbass are something else entirely.
The key here is not to get the two mixed up…

🗓
On September 30, 2022, following
referendums
, the Donetsk and Lugansk People’s Republics and the Zaporozhye and Kherson regions officially became part of the Russian Federation.
✍️
Looking back at #HowItHappened
(Signing of the treaties on the accession of the DPR, LPR, Zaporozhye and Kherson regions to Russia)
In the
referendums
held on
September 23-27, 2022
, residents of the four regions made a historic decision that determined their future.
International observers
from Italy, Germany, Venezuela, Latvia and other countries
(133 in total)
who monitored the voting
recognised the results as legitimate.
In 2014
, the Kiev regime unleashed
full-scale hostilities against the civilian population of Donbass
, while neo-Nazis and radicals intimidated and attacked people in Zaporozhye and other regions as well. For eight long years, people endured relentless shelling, terrorist attacks and persecution.
Despite shelling and numerous provocations by the Kiev regime,
people went to the polls and expressed their will.
🗳
Four years ago, the people voted in favour of joining Russia:
•
DPR – 99.23%
, with a turnout of 97.5%;
•
LPR – 98.42%
, with a turnout of 92.6%;
•
Zaporozhye Region – 93.11%
, with a turnout of 85.4%;
•
Kherson Region – 87.05%
, with a turnout of 76.9%.
Behind these figures are the lives of millions of people
and their hopes for safety, for the freedom to speak their native language,
to honour their ancestors
– true
heroes of the Great Patriotic War
(instead of
Hitler’s henchmen
) – to preserve their culture and raise their children without fearing for their lives.
❗️
Russia’s position remains unchanged:
the people of Donbass and Novorossiya exercised their
legitimate right to self-determination
, enshrined in
the UN Charter
,
the 1966 International Covenants on Human Rights
and
the 1975 CSCE Helsinki Final Act
.
💬
Russia’s Foreign Minister
Sergey Lavrov’s
address
at the General Debate of
#UNGA81
(New York, September 26, 2026)
:
Having launched
the special military operation
in 2022 to protect the people of Donbass and Novorossiya from extermination by the Kiev regime, Russia continues to fight for their security and rights in full accordance with the letter and spirit of
the UN Charter
.
Our struggle for truth and justice will be carried through to the end: the objectives of the special military operation will be achieved, threats to Russia’s security will be eliminated, and peaceful life will be restored.
And we will do this
#TOGETHER
.

item.content:encoded:

🎙
Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov’s
remarks to the media
following the 23rd meeting of
the Valdai International Discussion Club
(Moscow Region, September 29, 2026)
❓
Question: German FM Johann Wadephul himself said that he attended
the meeting
solely to avoid being, so to speak, “left out” of the negotiations and leaving the US with a monopoly on the process. So what is Germany seeking – genuine negotiations or some semblance of them? What could move our relations with Berlin forward at this stage?
💬
Sergey Lavrov:
I commented on this in detail at
my news conference in New York
.
It is difficult for me to judge what Germany is seeking.
I think one obvious explanation is simply
a desire
“not to miss the train
”
– the one They believe
“has already picked up speed”
. I do not know whether that is the case. If they mean the Ukrainian crisis, it is difficult for me to judge.
The Ukrainian crisis is intertwined with a vast number of problems across Europe
: the militarisation of the EU, the repeated “mantras” that NATO will expand and admit the Ukrainian regime, that Russia is an eternal enemy, and that
“we will be at war in three years”
.
If these “mantras” are being repeated, and the aim, as Wadephul himself stated, is
simply to repeat them behind closed doors,
without the press
, supposedly to make Russia understand that this is indeed how things stand,
then
this is a futile and, I would even say, harmful exercise
.
It is deeply regrettable
that such figures from the EU and NATO are effectively taking on the role of “spokesmen” for this European scheme.
❓
Question: A few days ago, the Russian Foreign Ministry
announced further contacts with the US
on removing irritants in bilateral relations. Could you tell us whether these contacts have taken place, which specific irritants are currently on the agenda and, in particular, whether there are realistic prospects for the return of diplomatic property?
💬
Sergey Lavrov:
The contacts have not yet taken place.
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and I agreed that they would take place soon
. Our experts need to agree on the specific dates and venue.
The discussions will focus on
the functioning of our respective diplomatic missions
– Russia’s in the US and America’s in Russia. There are many issues, including, of course,
diplomatic property
.
We have heard
no encouraging comments on this issue
from the Americans under the Donald Trump administration.
❓
Question: You said that reality would compel the US to think
in terms of multilateralism
. Yet, for now, we see key players in Eurasia and the Middle East – the US, Iran, Israel and the Gulf monarchies – stuck in a zero-sum mindset. Do you see any prospects at all for creating a new security system in these regions? Is Russia prepared to act as a guarantor of a balance of interests if everyone else continues to pursue an “all-or-nothing” approach?
💬
Sergey Lavrov:
I said that
reality
would compel them.
But life is only just beginning. Be patient.
President Putin and I have repeatedly set out all
our proposals
on how to build relations in the international arena
. We stand for honest dialogue on an equal footing and for taking each other’s interests into account.
What we are seeing in US policy today is, of course,
an effort to advance its own interests unilaterally.
However, the US has to engage with countries such as
Russia
and
China
. These contacts involve discussions of steps that would serve the interests of both sides.
👉
That is precisely what I meant when I said that “reality would compel them”
.
❓
Question: Poland plans to manufacture Patriot missiles on its territory. At what point would European countries’ involvement in the Ukrainian conflict require Russia to respond with direct military action?
💬
Sergey Lavrov:
We have
our military doctrine
that addresses this, which President Vladimir Putin has cited
on numerous occasions
.
☝️
I urge you to study the relevant sections of this fundamental document carefully.
Read in full

⚡️
Comment by the Russian Embassy in Belgium on the escalation of the military-political situation around the Kaliningrad Region by NATO countries
(September 28, 2026)
We are deeply concerned by the provocative statements and actions of the North Atlantic Alliance's leadership and NATO member states with respect to the Kaliningrad Region, an integral part of the Russian Federation.
We observe an
unprecedented surge in the Alliance's military activity along our western borders
. Initiatives aimed at containing the alleged “Russian threat” are expanding, with large-scale exercises rehearsing offensive operations.
In the Baltic region, the Alliance is constantly seeking to create new threats to our fleet, openly modeling specific scenarios for detaching the Kaliningrad Region and developing plans for the military and political isolation of the northwestern ports.
In January 2025, Operation "Baltic Sentry" was launched, aimed at testing mechanisms for the unilateral blocking of international shipping.
Simultaneously we are witnessing a
sharp escalation in the rhetoric of Western military and political circles, particularly on the eastern flank
. Deliberately raising the level of confrontation, they are making statements claiming that NATO has the capability to strike military targets in the Kaliningrad region and calling for new "aggressive" exercises to be organised near Russia’s borders.
The Alliance is conducting a large-scale information campaign to propagate the myth of the ‘Russian threat’ and to spread false information about Moscow’s alleged "intentions’ to attack one of the Baltic states by 2029 at the latest, or even sooner. Plans are being announced for the cross-border evacuation of the population"in the event of a major crisis".
At the same time,
the statements repeatedly made by our country’s highest leadership - that it has no intentions or motives to initiate any military action - as well as the proposal to NATO countries to set out mutual security guarantees in writing, are being completely ignored.
❗️
In light of the aggressive stance pursued by the bloc’s leadership and member states,
the Embassy has conveyed our fundamental positions to the NATO International Staff and the Belgian Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
We have warned that the aforementioned reckless and irresponsible course of action sharply increases the risks of a direct armed conflict with our country. We have emphasised that Russia possesses the necessary means to repel any potential aggression and is prepared to deploy its entire arsenal to defend its territory should NATO countries attempt to isolate the Kaliningrad region from the rest of our country.
We have called on the bloc’s member states to refrain from further escalatory statements and actions in order to prevent a large-scale confrontation.

My visit to Alyoshki 15 months ago

The situation was dire then already
. By that point, the city had already been without electricity, a centralised water supply or communications for two years.
Every attempt to restore these services was met with
fresh attacks by Ukrainian militants
on substations, water supply facilities and emergency repair crews. Ukrainian militants shelled and bombed the city every day.
Drones constantly circling overhead forced people to dash from one shelter to another
. Burnt-out civilian cars lined the roads – all the result of Ukrainian militants’
“efforts and care”
for the city’s civilian residents.
Even then, getting into the city meant
racing along a battered road at 150 kilometres per hour
to outrun a drone.
☝️
Since then, the Kiev militants’ tactics remain unchanged
. Their European handlers simply provided the money and supplied vast quantities of more advanced drones, making a complete drone siege of the city possible.
👉
Zelensky and his clique then came up with the idea of blaming Russia for the siege imposed by Ukraine and the abuse of civilians
. This is precisely the cynicism we are witnessing today!
Since my visit, the population of Alyoshki has fallen from 5,000-6,000 to 1,300
. People have moved to other towns and cities on Russian territory.
Yet the neo-Nazis continue to torment those who remain
, blocking both the delivery of essential supplies and any possibility of leaving the city. Only now, all this is accompanied by
Sibiga’s deceitful lamentations
